attribution: SoilGrids 2.0, ISRIC - World Soil Information (Poggio et al. 2021, SOIL 7, 217-240).
resolution_spatial: 250 m native; sampled from 0.004 degree WGS84 output grid
processing_notes: WCS mean coverages for clay, sand, silt, SOC and pH at 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm. Sampled at 49.109, -122.639, about 470 m from the KPU site point. Converted using SoilGrids d_factor and depth-weighted to 0-30 cm. Nearby proxy only; not a field soil test. Texture-to-infiltration class mapping is assumed (TODO(verify)).
